HowToShop.title: How to Place an Order
HowToShop.ariaLabel: Step-by-step guide on how to purchase products
HowToShop.step1: 1. Browse our curated collection, select your preferred items, and click <important>“Add to Cart”</important> to save them to your shopping bag.
HowToShop.step2: 2. Access your cart via the icon at the top right to review your items. You may adjust quantities or remove items before proceeding.
HowToShop.step3: 3. Once you have confirmed your selection, click <important>“Place Order”</important> to enter our secure checkout environment.
HowToShop.step4: 4. You will be redirected to Stripe, our secure payment gateway, to enter your details and complete your transaction safely.

CardPayment.title: Debit / Credit Card Payment
CardPayment.ariaLabel: Instructions for payment via debit or credit card
CardPayment.description: We support all major global payment networks. Secure payments can be made using debit or credit cards from any established bank worldwide.
CardPayment.acceptedCards: We accept cards with the <important>Visa, Mastercard, or JCB</important> logo, including virtual cards and international credit cards for your convenience.
CardPayment.securityNote: Your transaction is fully encrypted and protected by Stripe’s world-class security infrastructure.

QRCodePayment.title: QR Code Payment (Mobile Banking)
QRCodePayment.ariaLabel: Instructions for payment via QR Code
QRCodePayment.description: For a more efficient checkout, you may pay instantly via QR Code. This method is highly recommended for regional convenience.
QRCodePayment.method: Simply scan the <important>PromptPay QR Code</important> using your mobile banking app. This service is compatible with major banks and incurs no additional transaction fees.
QRCodePayment.expiryNote: * Please ensure your payment is finalised within the time limit shown on the checkout page to avoid order cancellation.

advertise.title: Why Honey & Olive Oil are the Top Choices for Health Enthusiasts?
messages: 100% pure honey is a clean, natural energy source that instantly revitalizes your body without the heavy, cloying sweetness of processed sugars.
Packed with high levels of natural antioxidants, it acts as a vital shield to boost your immune system and keep you feeling strong every single day.
Our premium olive oil is rich in healthy fats (HDL), an essential nutrient that actively supports heart health and promotes efficient blood circulation.
Switching to olive oil for your daily cooking helps lower bad cholesterol and significantly contributes to your long-term physical well-being and vitality.
The natural properties of honey provide excellent relief for sore throats while containing enzymes that help balance your digestive and excretory systems.
Rich in polyphenols, it helps slow down cellular aging while nourishing your skin to look radiant, healthy, and youthful from the inside out.
Carefully selected to ensure 100% natural origin, free from additives and zero trans fats, giving you complete peace of mind with every single serving.
The perfect choice for health enthusiasts, seniors, and anyone who pays close attention to the quality and origin of the ingredients they consume.
Incredibly versatile for any meal—whether you’re cooking your favorite dish, mixing it into a healthy drink, or enjoying it fresh for maximum benefits.
Don't wait for tomorrow; start prioritizing your health today by choosing premium, natural ingredients that truly make a difference in your life.
advertise.description: A healthier life is within reach—it all starts with choosing better, high-quality natural ingredients for your daily meals.
